name: movehere
description: Environment-aware workout generation, park-first. Confirmed venue features drive deterministic session generation.

scripts.verify: npm run typecheck:domain && npm run typecheck && npm run test:contracts && npm run test:runtime && npm run check:feasibility && npm run check:palette && npm run check:mobile-coverage && npm run check:exercise-media && npm run check:media-manifest && npm run check:instructions
scripts.check:media-manifest: node --experimental-strip-types scripts/exercise-media-manifest.mjs | diff -u docs/exercise-media-manifest.md - > /dev/null && echo "  manifest matches the matrix" || (echo "  docs/exercise-media-manifest.md is stale — run npm run media:manifest" && exit 1)
